title: Document unit
summary: Generates or repairs managed DocInsight comments for every public declaration in the unit open in the active editor (facts-only)
intro: Read this when the file you are editing needs documentation, not just one symbol. Right-click in the Structure form and choose Document unit to generate or repair managed DocInsight comments for every public declaration in the active editor file; the node you clicked does not matter.

surfaces.caption: Document unit
steps: Open the Structure form (drag-lint > Show Structure)
Choose Document unit; managed DocInsight comments are generated or repaired for its public declarations

surfaces.usage: drag-lint document --qname <Foo.TBar.Baz> [--apply|--json|--no-backup|--migrate-pure] [--db PATH] - generate/repair a managed DocInsight comment

questions.ask: How do I document all public declarations of one unit?
